Gran Colombia Domination focal seat 0 remains handicap-exempt; all adaptive CIVVIS rivals receive the chosen Immortal/Deity handicap. All six victories remain enabled.
first_unexposed_cohort.intervention_locked_before_reference_lau: Keep every actual safe movement decision. With builder-tries-the-next-tile enabled, after a successful adjacent step that neither follows the pre-step A* first tile nor reduces hex distance to the improvement job, clear the job pin and temporarily park it for the existing scaled six-standard-turn Builder avoidance window. No capture thresholds, global movement scores, difficulty, genome, force bundle, or game clocks change.
first_unexposed_cohort.comparison_scope: Matched whole-build regression, not focal-only treatment isolation: this bug fix affects every AdvancedAi controller in the candidate, including rivals. No Firaxis/Native or promotion inference from these games.
first_unexposed_cohort.primary: All terminal focal wins/losses and actual victory type, every seed retained.

first_unexposed_cohort.no_selection: Eight fresh random seeds chosen once before launch; no dropped losses, replaced seeds, shortened games, or victory gating. Implementation changes in response to these outcomes require a new explicitly exploratory cohort, not reusing this registration.

normal_sweep_cohort.profile: Same frozen current public force bundle and natural 250-turn 4p 60x38 Pangaea Online six-city-state setup as registration.json. Gran Colombia Domination focal seat 0 remains handicap-exempt; all adaptive CIVVIS rivals receive the chosen Immortal/Deity handicap. All six victories remain enabled.
normal_sweep_cohort.intervention_locked_before_reference_lau: Keep safe movement unchanged. Apply the job-progress helper to both normal and next-job sweeps and marginal-usefulness jobs. Track progress for risk-aware movement, not the unrelated builder-tries-the-next-tile opt-in. After a successful adjacent step not equal to the pre-step A* first tile and not closer to the job, clear its pin and park it for the existing six-standard-turn scaled avoidance. Preserve legacy movement, routed terrain detours, capture thresholds, genome, force bundle, clocks and all victories.
normal_sweep_cohort.prior_knowledge: The first eight fresh pairs and four known-map replays were action-identical and had no postponements. Static source inspection finds next-job mode absent from DEPLOYMENT_GENOME; the earlier helper was gated on that mode and the normal sweep bypassed it. Those results are retained as a separate unexposed negative cohort. No strength success has been observed.
normal_sweep_cohort.outcome_blinding: Do not inspect the new reference outcomes until all eight corrected-candidate fresh games and all eight candidate wrapper controls finish.
normal_sweep_cohort.no_selection: New seeds chosen once before launch following the first unexposed cohort. Retain all seeds, losses, action-identical pairs and natural terminals. Changes after these outcomes require another registration; this is whole-build regression, not isolated focal strength or Native verification.
